Migrate data between file-based and graph backends.

This command requires the migration binary to be installed and verified.
The binary must be code-signed and pass integrity verification.

The migration tool is a separate binary that can be installed via:
  - go install github.com/zqk-os/zqk/cmd/zqk-migrate@latest
  - Download from: https://github.com/zqk-os/zqk/releases

  Migrate from file to graph backend
  zqk.test utility migrate --source . --target memgraph
  Migrate specific phase
  zqk.test utility migrate --source . --target memgraph --phase entity

Usage:
  zqk.test utility migrate [flags]

Flags:
      --phase string                Migration phase (document, entity, relationship, all)
      --source string               Source path for migration
      --target string               Target backend (memgraph, neo4j, file)
      --version-constraint string   Version constraint (e.g., '>=1.0.0', '^1.0.0', '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0')
